description: This Java source file defines the ModelIndex class, which models an index element in an entity framework. It includes methods for creating index instances, converting to XML, and managing index properties such as name, uniqueness, and fields.

classes.name: ModelIndex
classes.description: A class representing a database index, including properties like name, uniqueness, and associated fields, with capabilities to create from XML and generate XML representations.

classes.name: ModelIndex.Field
classes.description: Inner class representing a field included in the index, with optional function applied to the field.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new ModelIndex instance with specified properties or from an XML Element.

methods.name: toXmlElement
methods.description: Converts the ModelIndex instance into an XML Element.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the index.

methods.name: getUnique
methods.description: Indicates whether the index enforces uniqueness.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns the list of fields included in the index.
